scope.note: a backup carries the original Run authority files, transactions, operations, receipts, approved payloads with versions, knowledge closeout records, and database/object/config/permission refs; the directory-form workspace is the real backed-up artifact

manifest.note: every manifest entry is a real sha256 over the real copied bytes; the backup re-reads and re-hashes the target after writing and refuses on any mismatch

consistency.note: a transaction left open means there is no consistent point in time to back up; db and objects watermarks must agree for the restore to later enable

encryption.note: backup encryption is referenced, never valued; actual encryption stays UNVERIFIED until a runtime-authorized secret store exists, and restoration stops if the key is unavailable

codeSourceCache.note: revoked code-source caches are recorded by reference with restored=false and their bytes are never copied; a restore must not reuse them

comet050DataSurfaces.note: the comet-050 backup inventory: every data plane that must survive backup/restore is registered item by item with its anchor (env-anchored or repo-relative, never host-absolute), format and restore prerequisites; anchors without local presence or with restore channels outside this task's scope are honestly statused

dataSurfaces.format: native directory tree: runtime/ (change-owners/<owner>/<change>.json comet.change-owner.v1, sdk-runs/<owner>/.runtime-store-v2/<hash>/checkpoint.json comet.runtime-store-snapshot.v2, state-projections, .change-owner-partitions.json) plus observability/ (performance.sqlite)
restorePrerequisites: process-level old-writer fence evidence (live pid refutes any gone-claim)
dedicated quarantine target with no live second writer
native schema readback of comet.change-owner.v1 and comet.runtime-store-snapshot.v2 proving the same run identity before release
dataSurfaces.status: MECHANISM_VERIFIED_LOCALLY (fixtures + real-host drill evidence in worker-reports/I08-comet-050)

dataSurfaces.format: git project tree (Python stdio MCP, web app, converter) — bytes are the project, not derived state
restorePrerequisites: byte-level copy verification against a per-file sha256 manifest
MCP startup readback belongs to the I03/I04 tools; this task restores and byte-verifies the tree
dataSurfaces.status: DIRECTORY_RESTORE_VERIFIED_LOCALLY (real-host drill in worker-reports/I08-comet-050); MCP startup readback UNVERIFIED in this task's timebox

dataSurfaces.format: LLMWiki wiki home: .llmwiki/index.db (sqlite) plus the compiled wiki content tree
restorePrerequisites: sqlite file restore requires the owning project stopped (no live writer on index.db)
restored wiki home must be re-bound through SDD_WIKI_HOME before any MCP readback
dataSurfaces.status: NO_SDD_HARNESS_WIKI_DB_EXISTS_LOCALLY as of 2026-10-26 (observed honestly; only a pav2 wiki exists under ~/.sdd/wiki and belongs to another project)

dataSurfaces.anchor: .sdd/outline/runtime/ (compose config; secrets referenced via secrets.env, never valued) plus docker volumes outline_outline-db (PostgreSQL) and outline_outline-data
dataSurfaces.format: docker compose config + PostgreSQL volume + Redis volume backing the Outline team knowledge instance
restorePrerequisites: docker volume restore requires deployment-wave authorization and a stopped Outline stack
secrets.env refs must be re-authorized through the I01 read-only gate before any restore drill
point-in-time consistency between the PG volume and its wal must be proven by the backup owner
dataSurfaces.status: UNVERIFIED — PG/Redis volume restore requires docker operations not performed in this task; volumes registered read-only

dataSurfaces.anchor: docker volume outline_outline-attachments (served by the outline-object-store service)
dataSurfaces.format: object-store attachment bytes (uploaded documents/files referenced by Outline documents)
restorePrerequisites: attachment restore must keep point-in-time consistency with the PG volume (db/objects watermarks must agree)
an attachment-missing restore must not be released as complete
dataSurfaces.status: UNVERIFIED — attachment volume restore requires docker operations not performed in this task; volume registered read-only

neverIncluded: secret values (only secret-ref entries, never resolved)
host absolute paths (repo-relative or redacted receipts only)

retention.ruleA: R10 A: an unresolved Run or knowledge obligation retains the sole workspace; the existence of a backup never justifies early cleanup
retention.obligationSource: Comet real obligations (open transactions, dispatched-but-unreceipted remote operations, pending knowledge closeouts, sole-copy approved payloads, and the comet-050 native runtime-store checkpoint status of the run itself) — never just archived/git-complete state
retention.note: capacity shortfalls raise warnings only; a silent or timed cleanup of the sole unfinished workspace is forbidden. The boundary moves only after verified completion, or after a separately approved controlled migration whose restore has been proven.
